title: Brilliant tour! ✨
text:
Incredible tour - Sandra was amazing.
Super knowledgable with some incredible hidden facts about Barcelona, symbolism and a lot lot more! We could have happily spent a few more hours in her company 🌹❤️✨ if you are looking for a deeper conscious off the beaten track tour, this is the one for you.  We loved it!
author: Alison O

title: Hidden secrets of Barcelona
text:
Sandra was not only incredibly knowledgeable but was also friendly, approachable and fun. I learnt so much from her and thoroughly enjoyed our time together.

We walked around main areas of town and smaller hidden pockets to see the influences and history of mysticism and esotericism in Barcelona. I was also given a history of the area itself and of Sandra’s experience and knowledge of these subjects.

I highly recommend this tour to anyone who is interested in the hidden and often overlooked and covered up aspects of history.

Thanks Sandra!
author: Emma B

title: Eye-Opening Esoteric Tour with Sandra
text: Sandra’s esoteric tour was absolutely fascinating. She gave me a whole new way to look at Barcelona — not just through its history and architecture, but through the layers of symbolism, mystery, and meaning hidden within the city. Her passion and depth of knowledge made the experience unforgettable, and I came away with a better understanding and appreciation of esoterism in general. If you’re looking for something unique and mind-opening in Barcelona, I can’t recommend this tour highly enough!

title: Mystical Barcelona!!
text:
Fabulous tour!! Our guide Sandra was extremely knowledgeable and interesting. A unique experience!!!
    Very wide ranging information on Christianity. Kabbalah, Phillip Lindsay, Gaudi, the Freemasons, Rosicrucians and others from am esoteric perspective.
author: joycecritelli

title: Best choice in Barcelona!
text: Hands down the highlight of my trip. Sandra was knowledgeable, energetic, engaging and absolutely delightful all around. Her depth of information combined with her obvious passion for esoterics was infectious and both rekindled my love of the subject as well as motivated me to seek deeper learning. Thank you Sandra!!
author: Erin_K

title: Fascinating tour
text: This tour was an incredible dive into the history of Barcelona and Western esotericism. I think I heard hundreds of stories and historical facts about Templars, Masons, alchemy, mysticism, Kabballah, and Tarot, and, and, and... during our three-hour tour as we walked on the narrow streets of the Barri Gotic. Very fascinating! After the tour, my head was spinning from all this. If you feel at all at home with the subject matter, I highly recommend it. Sandra has an incredible repository of information, and she even starts the tour just for you.
author: Irma_R

title: Remarkable, knowledgeable tour guide
text:
Amazing tour of the secret history- everything from the Roman burial grounds, Rosicrucianism, mysticism, Kabbalah, building masonry and the connections between them. Even gave us info on alchemy and Tarot cards. We thoroughly enjoyed the spiritual connection to all the topics.
Sandra is extremely passionate about her continuing lifelong education and pursuit
of the numerous subjects. She has a talent to explain in detail all the time understanding we are laymen. I highly recommend this enthusiastic, passionate, remarkably knowledgably tour guide
